decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an abrupt multi-sample shift near index 486–487 with sustained offset in all axes, and (2) a sharp N/E/U excursion starting at index 608 with ambiguous return behavior through 612. Both show superposed changes and lack clear reversal within the observed windows.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample shift in N and E (N from ~-1.2 to +1.0, E from ~-2.35 to -2.48) at index 486–487, followed by a sustained offset; U shows a concurrent drop (~-3.5 to -0.9). The change is abrupt and not clearly reversed within the window.

Complex cross-axis behavior: N jumps from ~0.98 to 3.19 at index 608, while E rises from ~0.60 to 1.32 and U shifts from -0.43 to +0.55; then N drops sharply to 1.38 at 609 with E and U also changing direction. A possible platform or opposing return begins around 610–612 but remains ambiguous due to overlapping motion across axes.
